description: This file contains extension methods for configuring Azure deployment balancers in Orleans hosting and an interface defining runtime wrapper properties for Azure services.

classes.name: SiloPersistentStreamConfiguratorExtension
classes.description: Provides extension methods for configuring Azure deployment balancers in Orleans silo persistent stream configurations.

classes.name: IServiceRuntimeWrapper
classes.description: Defines properties and methods for interacting with Azure runtime runtime wrappers, such as retrieving deployment info and subscribing for notifications.

methods.name: UseDynamicAzureDeploymentBalancer
methods.description: Configures the silo persistent stream with a dynamic Azure deployment balancer, optionally specifying a maturity period.

methods.name: UseStaticAzureDeploymentBalancer
methods.description: Configures the silo persistent stream with a static Azure deployment balancer, optionally specifying a maturity period.

methods.name: GetConfigurationSettingValue
methods.description: Retrieves configuration setting value by name from the Azure runtime environment.

methods.name: GetIPEndpoint
methods.description: Gets IP endpoint information for a given endpoint name.

methods.name: SubscribeForStoppingNotification
methods.description: Subscribes to stopping notifications with a handler object and event handler.

methods.name: UnsubscribeFromStoppingNotification
methods.description: Unsubscribes from stopping notifications with a handler object and event handler.
